title: Plan a new backup-only NFS storage
summary: Prepare a bound check-mode plan for one new explicitly selected NFS storage; planning does not mount or contact a host.

target.description: One explicit target from the private environment

expected_results: A static plan bound to the recipe, collection, private target and variables
No host, NAS or package changes during planning

known_failures.summary: Create-only registration refuses an existing storage ID or mountpoint
next_checks: Inspect the prior registration, actual backing and retained operation evidence
recovery: Reconcile partial work; do not force adoption or delete an unowned path

known_failures.summary: Server reachability or an active storage status does not establish a completed backup
next_checks: Check export authorization, mount backing/options and the owned destination
recovery: Retain partial evidence and stop before backup writes

provenance.qualification: Local recipe, role guard and plan contracts
limitations: Planning is static and requirements are descriptive metadata
No independent backup, restore or physical-host-loss qualification
